body.purpose: All prose, labels, headings, nav — Rethink Sans.

numeral.purpose: Every numeral, currency code, and reference identifier only — IBM Plex Mono, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting hairline elevation for Card, wallet cells, bordered containers.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color transitions, nav item state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; cyan fill, hover glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgb(8 145 178); color: rgb(247 248 252); border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Rethink Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(8 145 178 / 0.5), 0 0 16px -6px rgb(8 145 178 / 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(8 145 178); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent-fill button for secondary actions (Pause/Resume, Log out).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: rgb(18 23 43); border: 1px solid rgb(219 223 235); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Rethink Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(238 240 247); border-color: rgb(8 145 178 / 0.4); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard bordered container: forms, goal cards, transaction rows.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgb(255 255 255); border: 1px solid rgb(219 223 235); border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(219 223 235); padding: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Labeled text input with error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Rethink Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(18 23 43); } .ds-field input { background: rgb(255 255 255); color: rgb(18 23 43); border: 1px solid rgb(219 223 235); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; transition: border-color 120ms; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgb(91 97 120); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(8 145 178); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Per-module nav link with fixed accent color on active state (module-specific left border + tint).
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(91 97 120); font-family: 'Rethink Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 120ms, background-color 120ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(238 240 247); color: rgb(18 23 43); } .ds-nav-item--active { border-left-color: rgb(37 99 235); background: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.1); color: rgb(37 99 235); }

components.name: BeadRow
components.description: Discrete bead-fill progress mark for a genuine fraction-of-N (wallet share of total, vault goal progress). Never decorative.
components.css: .ds-bead-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-bead { height: 0.5rem; width: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(219 223 235); background: transparent; } .ds-bead--filled { background: rgb(8 145 178); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Wallet Rod Cell
components.description: One currency cell in the hairline rod-grid: accent dot, mono currency code, mono balance, BeadRow.
components.css: .ds-wallet-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; background: rgb(255 255 255); padding: 1rem; } .ds-wallet-dot { height: 0.375rem; width: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(8 145 178); } .ds-wallet-code { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgb(91 97 120); } .ds-wallet-balance { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgb(18 23 43); }

components.name: Badge (Approved Stamp)
components.description: KYC status pill; APPROVED renders a rotated stamp icon instead of the shared dot marker.
components.html: APPROVED
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-badge--approved { border: 1px solid rgb(191 63 42 / 0.5); background: rgb(191 63 42 / 0.1); color: rgb(191 63 42); } .ds-badge-stamp { height: 0.75rem; width: 0.75rem; transform: rotate(-12deg); }

narrative.overview: ManekPay's shipped visual system reads as a suanpan (counting frame): currencies are rods, balances are discrete beads, and the whole product refuses the soft gradient card-grid every neobank ships. The frame is a navy-and-cyan instrument that displays exact figures in tabular mono numerals rather than gesturing at wealth with big rounded panels — the interface wants to be trusted like a precise tool, not liked like a toy. This is a flat, rectilinear, hairline-bordered system. There is no glassmorphism, no soft blur shadow, no card floating above a gradient backdrop. Depth is conveyed by a single 1px border ring (shadow-card), not by elevation. The one deliberately warm, non-navy/cyan mark is the stamp-ink vermillion used exclusively for the KYC-approved state — a customs-clearance stamp, not a routine status pill, and never repurposed for a money-negative state. The system's discipline is legibility over ornament: every numeral renders in IBM Plex Mono for tabular alignment, every wallet balance sits beside a real bead-fill fraction (never a decorative one), and the five functional modules (Ledger, FX, Vaults, Risk, Wealth) each carry one fixed accent hue used consistently across sidebar nav, page icon, and page-local data marks.
keyCharacteristics: Rectilinear, tight-radius geometry (2-5px) - rods and frames have definite edges, not soft plastic corners.
Hairline 1px border elevation only; no blurred/soft box-shadow ever used for depth.
IBM Plex Mono strictly scoped to numerals, currency codes, and reference numbers - never prose, headers, or nav labels.
Discrete bead-fill (BeadRow) as the system's one custom data mark, used only where a real fraction-of-N exists.
Per-module fixed accent color (ledger blue, fx green, vaults amber, risk rose, wealth violet) carried consistently from sidebar to page icon to page-local marks.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp-ink vermillion marks exactly one state system-wide - KYC APPROVED. It is not a general "success" or "verified" color; success/positive states elsewhere use success green.

rules.name: The Module Accent Consistency Rule
rules.body: A module's accent color, once assigned (Sidebar NAV_ITEMS), must be reused for that module's PageHeader icon chip and any page-local data mark on that module's page. Accents are not decorative - they are the wayfinding system across five concurrent currency/module contexts.

rules.name: The Every-Numeral Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono renders every numeral, currency code, and reference/account identifier in the product - and nothing else. A prose sentence, a section header, or a nav label never switches face mid-string; only the digits/codes within do.

rules.name: The Flush Rod Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit at the same visual plane as their frame at rest. Depth is a hairline border, never a blurred shadow; any glow appears only as a hover response, never as ambient decoration.

dos: Do render every numeral, currency code, and reference/account identifier in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums; keep prose, headers, and nav labels in Rethink Sans.
Do reuse a module's fixed accent color (ledger/fx/vaults/risk/wealth) consistently across its sidebar nav state, PageHeader icon chip, and any page-local data mark.
Do use BeadRow only where a genuine fraction-of-N exists (wallet share of total, goal progress toward target); render every other quantity as a plain mono numeral.
Do keep elevation to the 1px shadow-card hairline at rest; reserve shadow-glow for hover-only interactive feedback.
Do keep corner radii at or below 5px (sm 2px / md 3px / lg 5px) across all components.
donts: Don't apply IBM Plex Mono to prose, section headers, or nav labels - it is scoped strictly to numerals and short data-identifiers, corrected during finish review after an earlier draft over-applied it as decorative "technical costume."
Don't use a blurred/soft box-shadow for resting elevation anywhere; this system conveys depth with hairline borders only, not floating cards.
Don't introduce kicker/eyebrow labels above headings - none exist in the shipped system.
Don't repurpose stamp-ink vermillion for any state other than KYC APPROVED; it is not a general "success" or "verified" color.
Don't render Dashboard's module quick-links as a card grid - the shipped pattern is a single flat function-key row with hairline dividers, not separated tiles.
